xBRIEFInfo.description: Story xBRIEF for #1704 — maintainer/process gate-throughput: fast-lane policy, CI monolith, merge queue; cache engine stays in #1713.

plan.title: RFC: gate throughput without quality loss — process levers (fast lane, CI monolith, merge queue)

narratives.Description: Raise gate throughput without quality loss on the maintainer/process face. Keep the full-gate-at-merge invariant while making the iteration lane cheap for agents and humans. In-engine content-hash cache and runner-delegated affected selection are owned by #1713; this story ships skill/CI/merge-queue policy that makes the invariant real.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Update content/skills/deft-directive-build/SKILL.md, content/skills/deft-directive-swarm/SKILL.md, and content/skills/deft-directive-pre-pr/SKILL.md so iteration uses affected/static fast lane and full task check is required at PR/merge only (agents + humans). 2. Close the CI enforcement gap: required merge check on master invokes task check or check:merge as a single SoT in .github/workflows (not only drifted discrete steps). 3. Wire escape-rate consumption guidance to #1703 Tier-1 (do not invent a new metric home). 4. Adopt GitHub merge queue or document explicit deferral with rationale in the PR. 5. Document before/after cost model on one swarm-heavy path. 6. CHANGELOG [Unreleased]. Verify with task ts:test and targeted workflow validation; task check at merge.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive maintainer running swarm workers, I want iteration to use a cheap fast lane while merge still runs the full gate, so that agent loops stop paying full task check on every commit without losing the merge invariant.

narrative.Acceptance: Given build, swarm, and pre-pr skills, when an agent iterates, then guidance requires affected/static fast lane (not full task check every commit) and requires full task check at PR/merge for agents and humans.
Given required CI on master/merge, when a PR merges, then task check or check:merge runs as the single source of truth rather than only a drifted discrete-step re-implementation.
Given #1703 Tier-1, when fast-lane defaults ship, then escape-rate is referenced as the safety proof; merge queue is adopted or explicitly deferred with rationale in the PR body.

Given the PR, when reviewed, then it states #1713 owns in-engine cache/affected runner plumbing, and documents a before/after move toward O(merges x full-gate) + O(iterations x cheap-proxy) on at least one swarm path; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] updated.

expected_outputs: Fast-lane skill policy; CI monolith SoT; merge queue or deferral; #1713 boundary noted; CHANGELOG
